'''Grommik's Residence''' was a [[Moisture farm/Legends|moisture farm]] owned by [[Grommik Kurthson]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TOR:LOO" />
{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Grommik's Residence appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The game map identified the moisture farm was as "Grommik's Residence" during the quest "Last One Out."<ref name="TOR:LOO" /> However, the mission "Race Against Doom" identified the same farm as "Bak’arap Farmstead."<ref name="TOR:RAD">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Last One Out|Race Against Doom}}</ref> This is apparently a mistake as the game map identified another moisture farm, located in [[Northern Jundland Wastes|Northern Wastes]], as [[Bak'arap Farmstead]].<ref name="TOR:MP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Malicious Persecution|Tatooine}}</ref> The description of the mission "Jawa Justice" also identified the farm in the Northern Wastes as Bak'arap Farmstead.<ref name="TOR:JJ">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Jawa Justice|Tatooine}}</ref>
